description.value: Angel Estate Winery sits on Westham Island Road in the agricultural flatlands of the Fraser River delta, a scenic rural cycling area accessible from the Ladner area of Delta, BC. Tagged in OSM as both a craft winery and an alcohol shop, it appears to operate as an estate winery with on-site sales. The pastoral delta setting — dyke roads, farmland, and river views — makes it a natural waypoint for cyclists exploring the South Delta cycling network.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website fetch returned a Wix domain-not-connected error page (385 bytes of boilerplate), providing zero usable content about amenities, hours, or contact details — effectively a prefetch failure for evidence purposes. All amenity fields default to null. OSM tags supply the name, address, phone, opening_hours (Tu-Su 11:00-18:00), and craft=winery/shop=alcohol, which together confirm this is a real operating winery; looks_closed is false. The OSM community field says 'Richmond' but postal code V4K 3N2 and Westham Island Road are within Delta, BC — flagged as a concern.
concerns: Website domain not connected: angelestatewinery.com returns a Wix setup/placeholder page, making all amenity fields unverifiable from the website.
OSM community field lists 'Richmond' but the address (2170 Westham Island Road, V4K 3N2) is in Delta, BC — possible community mis-assignment in OSM.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating estate winery with OSM opening hours, phone, and no closure signals — a legitimate cycling-area destination in the Fraser delta. Website being temporarily down does not indicate closure.
enrichment_extras.notes: Westham Island is a popular rural cycling destination accessible via the Westham Island swing bridge from Ladner. A future volunteer visit or phone call could confirm bike parking, washrooms, and whether wine can be taken away.

wow_evidence: estate winery with on-site sales ... pastoral delta setting — dyke roads, farmland, and river views
